outcome_sought: Cover the extra £360 he would pay for resale tickets, or other compensation, and reassurance that the app will not keep failing.
rationale: The customer complained about app access in August and that complaint was closed on 12 Aug, so this is a repeat on the same subject within twelve months and CP-2.4 requires the link to be recorded. The cards log ties his failed purchase to in-app 3DS approvals being unavailable during the 30 Oct outage, which is also a root-cause point under CP-10.2. Whether to compensate the resale cost is a decision for a person, not the pack.
